client_assignments.schema:
CREATE TABLE client_assignments (
                    episode_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    client_instance_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    agent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    PRIMARY KEY (episode_id, client_instance_id),
                    UNIQUE (episode_id, agent_id),
                    FOREIGN KEY (episode_id) REFERENCES episodes(episode_id)
                )

connector_sessions.schema:
CREATE TABLE connector_sessions (
                    episode_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    connector_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    client_host TEXT NOT NULL,
                    agent_id TEXT,
                    registered_at TEXT NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'operator', target_agent_id TEXT,
                    PRIMARY KEY (episode_id, connector_id),
                    FOREIGN KEY (episode_id) REFERENCES episodes(episode_id)
                )

episodes.schema:
CREATE TABLE episodes (
                    episode_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    state TEXT NOT NULL,
                    config_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                    agents_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    reject_reason TEXT
                )

heartbeats.schema:
CREATE TABLE heartbeats (
                    episode_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    agent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                    received_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    PRIMARY KEY (episode_id, agent_id),
                    FOREIGN KEY (episode_id) REFERENCES episodes(episode_id)
                )

jobs.schema:
CREATE TABLE jobs (
                episode_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
                completed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, first_pending REAL NOT NULL,
                due REAL NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
                attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, error TEXT)

accepted_records.schema:
CREATE TABLE accepted_records (
                    episode_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    channel TEXT NOT NULL,
                    producer_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    sample_seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    PRIMARY KEY (episode_id, channel, producer_id, sample_seq)
                )

world_clocks.schema:
CREATE TABLE world_clocks (
                    episode_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    sample_seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    server_monotonic_ns INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    ingestor_received_monotonic_ns INTEGER NOT NULL
                )
